hero.subheadline: Professional, insured, and detail-oriented cleaning services designed for consistent, high-quality results.

about.paragraph1: Clean & Shine is a professional cleaning company serving Georgia with dedication, care, and trust. We take pride in our work and treat every home as if it were our own, ensuring quality, consistency, and trust in every visit.
about.paragraph2: Led by Bruna, our team is trained to deliver a consistently high standard — from the everyday details to the hard-to-reach spots. Whether it's a weekly recurring service or a one-time deep clean, we show up ready to deliver results.
about.paragraph3: We serve multiple cities and neighborhoods across Georgia. Share your ZIP code when requesting an estimate and we will confirm availability for your address.

services.title: Recurring Home Cleaning
services.tagline: Enjoy the comfort of a consistently clean home with reliable scheduled visits and attention to detail.
services.description: Life gets busy — cleaning should not be overwhelming. Regular cleaning keeps your home welcoming, healthy, and stress-free without you having to think about it. Enjoy more free time while we handle the details and maintain your space at a consistently high standard.
highlights: More free time while we handle every detail
Your home stays welcoming, healthy, and always ready

services.title: Deep Cleaning
services.tagline: When your home needs more than maintenance, we deliver a complete refresh with detail-focused deep cleaning.
services.description: Deep cleaning is ideal when your home needs more than routine maintenance. We remove buildup, hidden dust, and neglected areas that regular cleaning does not fully address, restoring your home to a higher standard and creating the perfect foundation for ongoing recurring service.
highlights: Removes buildup, hidden dust, and neglected areas
Heavy-duty products for deep cleaning when necessary
Complete reset for a noticeably fresher home

services.title: Commercial Cleaning
services.tagline: A spotless, sanitary, and welcoming environment for your staff and visitors with reliable commercial service.
services.description: A clean workspace reflects your business standards. Our commercial cleaning service is built on consistency, attention to detail, and dependable execution you can count on. We offer customized plans to match your business routine and facility requirements.
highlights: Customized plans for your business routine
We use high-grade equipment and specialized chemicals

services.title: Move In/Out Cleaning
services.tagline: Detailed top-to-bottom cleaning to prepare your property for move-in, move-out, or final inspection.
services.description: Our Move In / Move Out Cleaning is a detailed deep cleaning designed to prepare your home for its next chapter. This service is ideal for tenants, homeowners, landlords, and real estate transitions. We clean inside cabinets, appliances, bathrooms, baseboards, doors, and hard-to-reach areas so the property is spotless, sanitized, and ready for move-in or final inspection.
highlights: Inside cabinets, appliances, and hard-to-reach areas
Ideal for tenants, homeowners, and landlords
Ready for move-in or final inspection
